object_entity.event_label: Sardinian Exile of Hippolytus and Pontian
object_entity.notes: Bishop Pontian and the schismatic Hippolytus were both exiled to the mines of Sardinia in 235 under Emperor Maximinus Thrax; they were reconciled before death; their bodies were brought back to Rome by Pope Fabian c. 236.

evidence.notes: Eusebius and the Liberian Catalogue attest the exile of both Hippolytus and Pontian to Sardinia.

passage.excerpt: Paraphrase: Eusebius reports that Hippolytus was a bishop somewhere and that he composed various works. In HE 6.43, Eusebius preserves a letter of Cornelius of Rome describing Novatian's ordination as rival bishop and the condemnation of his rigorist position by a Roman synod of sixty bishops.
passage.notes: Eusebius testimony to Hippolytus's episcopacy and works; Cornelius's letter on Novatian schism; Roman synod against Novatian
